description: This file implements internal functions and data structures for rendering commit graphs in a version control system, including handling of different graph states, column management, and output formatting.

classes.name: struct column
classes.description: Represents a branch column in the commit graph, holding a reference to a commit and its display color.

classes.name: enum graph_state
classes.description: Enumerates the various states of the graph rendering process, such as padding, skipping, pre-commit, commit, post-merge, and collapsing.

classes.name: struct graph_line
classes.description: Represents a line in the graph output buffer, including its buffer and width.

classes.name: struct git_graph
classes.description: Main data structure managing the state and rendering of the commit graph, including columns, layout, and output state.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Initializes a new git_graph structure with default settings and allocates necessary resources.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a git_graph instance.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph state with a new commit, recalculating columns and layout.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Generates the next line of the graph output based on current state.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Outputs the full commit graph lines for a given commit.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Outputs a single line representation of the commit graph.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Outputs a padding line in the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Outputs remaining lines of the graph for the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Displays the commit message along with the graph lines.
